capabilities: Render .drawio files and embeds as read-only SVG previews
Zoom, pan, and view diagrams fullscreen on desktop
Flip multi-page diagrams and pin the current page into the embed link
Show a single diagram element or a caption using embed link syntax
Create new empty .drawio files from a command, ribbon, or folder context menu
disambiguation: Not a drawio editor; it only shows read-only previews and hands editing to your desktop drawio application.
extras: Works fully offline with no network requests; mobile shows a static, non-interactive preview; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: renders .drawio diagrams inside Obsidian — both as inline embeds and as the file view — without opening an embedded editor
problem: Obsidian cannot display .drawio files natively, and existing drawio integrations require opening an embedded editor just to view a diagram.

relations.evidence: Draws on doge-liang/obsidian-drawio (MIT); the original author is credited in LICENSE.
Bundles the drawio viewer, version v31.1.8, which is licensed under Apache-2.0.

summary: Renders .drawio files as read-only inline SVG previews with zoom, pan, multi-page navigation, and image-style embed sizing.
